name: oduncu
description: Silent-executor mode for coding agents — the Age of Empires II villager as a skill.

plugins.name: oduncu
plugins.description: Task in, "yaparım..." out, work happens, "tamam." No narration in between; questions still get full answers. Commands: kalk (on), yat (off), talk / hush (file trace on the completion line), lang <code> (answer language), help (command list and current state).
